series_name: Banished from the Hero's Party I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside
title: Banished from the Hero's Party I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside
synopsis: After being betrayed by the Hero’s party, Red hopes to start anew by opening an apothecary in a small town. He wants to keep his past life secret, but it won’t be easy...especially when a beautiful adventurer from his past asks to move in.
